title: Audit
description: The immutable trail — who did what, when, and under what authority

trail.caption: Audit Trail
trail.empty: No audit events in this scope

reference.caption: Reference Format
reference.note: Each audit event carries: Who, What, When, Why, Authority, Result, Reference.

backendNote: Backend integration comes in a later phase. Audit events are appended by the backend only. The UI never writes to the audit trail.
